question: A and B can do a piece of work in 5 days, while C and D can do the same work in 20 days. In how many days will A, B, C and D do it together?
solution:
**Given:**

A and B can do a piece of work in 5 days.

C and D can do the same work in 20 days.

**Formula used:**

Work Rate = 1 / Number of Days

Combined Work Rate = Sum of Individual Work Rates

Total Days to Complete Work = 1 / Combined Work Rate
